---
title: "survXsize"
output: html_document
---

```{r Packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r Load Data}
surv_size_g <- read.csv("surv_size.csv")
```

```{r Survival v Size}
surv_size_g %>% ggplot(aes(x = survival, y = area)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = Treatment, size = Day), size = 2) +
  geom_path(aes(group = Treatment, color = Treatment), size = 1.25) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#f678d8", "#1f59c5", "#82ad0f", "#ee8e36", "#16b4eb", "#15b418", "#bc58dc")) +
  labs(x = "Survival", y = "Area")
```
